title: 瑞穗金融集团：日元不像G10货币，更像新兴市场？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Well, from all of the frameworks, dolian should be lower. The classic frameworks. We should be talking 140, 150.
segments.zh: 从所有框架来看，日元应该走低。经典框架下，我们该讨论140、150的水平。

segments.en: If you use interest rate spreads as your guide, that's why a lot of guests would have come on your show and say the weakness in the end is going to be short term.
segments.zh: 如果以利差为指引，很多嘉宾会说日元弱势是短期的。

segments.en: I think dolian heads low into year-end. But there's been a change in the flow behaviors of the Japanese space.
segments.zh: 我认为日元年底前会走低，但日本市场的资金流动行为已发生变化。

segments.en: It doesn't look like a G10 currency. It trades like an EM.
segments.zh: 它不像G10货币，更像新兴市场货币。

segments.en: In terms of its correlation to rates, it has flipped. It's got a negative correlation to rates right now.
segments.zh: 与利率的相关性已经反转，目前呈负相关。

segments.en: And this is something that we don't usually talk about. What we have spoken about for the UK over Brexit, all these other things.
segments.zh: 这是我们通常不讨论的。我们曾讨论过英国脱欧等情况。

segments.en: And that was when everyone was worrying about the fiscal side in the UK. So is it the same concern over in the states in Japan?
segments.zh: 当时大家担心英国财政问题。那么美国和日本也有同样担忧吗？

segments.en: There's definitely concerns. We're waiting to see what the consumption tax cut will be on food and what other ways they're going to fund that.
segments.zh: 确实有担忧。我们等待看食品消费税减免以及如何融资。

segments.en: They said they'll fund it from higher revenues. But the market thinks it's sniffing around, thinking there's going to be some extra deficit financing bonds.
segments.zh: 官方称将通过更高收入融资，但市场认为可能发行额外赤字融资债券。

segments.en: But the main point is Japan's not on EM. And actually, we've seen massive inflows in Japan.
segments.zh: 但关键是日本并非新兴市场。实际上，我们看到日本有大量资金流入。

segments.en: The biggest inflows in fact over the past year by foreign investors into both JGBs and equities.
segments.zh: 过去一年，外国市场参与者对日本国债和权益资产的最大资金流入。

segments.en: But those foreign investors, after Liberation Day, are massively hedging their exposure.
segments.zh: 但解放日后，这些外国市场参与者大规模对冲了敞口。

segments.en: So you've got that inflow into Japan, potentially crowding out Japanese investors who are also investing abroad.
segments.zh: 资金流入日本，可能挤出了也在海外**的日本市场参与者。

segments.en: But they don't FX hedge the same way as foreign investors, because they have to pay for that FX hedge, where Europeans and US get paid for it.
segments.zh: 但他们不像外国市场参与者那样进行外汇对冲，因为日本市场参与者需支付对冲成本，而欧美市场参与者则能获得收益。

segments.en: So that's your question. We've had a big carry trade, where a lot of hedge friends are short.
segments.zh: 这就是问题所在。我们经历了一场大规模套利交易，许多对冲基金做空日元。

segments.en: The yen, a lot of CTAs and trend following accounts. Yesterday looked like something different.
segments.zh: 许多CTA和趋势跟踪账户也做空。但昨天情况有所不同。
